status_at_creation: before this round's gate development scores and new holdout results
registration: local timestamped plan, not public preregistration
historical_status: old LUDB and MIT-BIH outputs already inspected; used for hypothesis formation, not new blinded evidence

matched_factorial.selection: minimize mean quiet nRMSE among development candidates with active nRMSE <= 1.01*best development local mean; if infeasible, declare and select minimum whole NMSE
matched_factorial.original_background: alpha=3,c=2 retained separately, never silently replaced
matched_factorial.curve_assessment: compare frozen development-selected operating points; any further frontier evaluated from development only

strong_neighbor.rule: retrieve and inspect public supplementary material before implementing; save implementation-fidelity addendum before its development scores; do not claim author-code parity without evidence

stress.records: first, fourth, seventh, ... of the 60 new holdout records: 2,11,...,173; 20 records
stress.geometry: equal length cells covering ten seconds; each cell has a centered burst with duration fraction*cell length; 100 ms cosine edges capped at one quarter burst length
stress.continuous: fraction=1 has envelope identically one; execute once per record/noise/seed, not duplicate for burst count
stress.missing_regions: NA when quiet/active mask has no valid samples; never substitute zero

statistics.within_record: equal-weight mean across declared conditions before between-method comparison
statistics.contrast: 100*(mean record metric method A / mean record metric method B - 1)
statistics.interpretation: descriptive intervals; no unplanned multiplicity-adjusted significance claims; convenience sample, shared physical noise source
statistics.subgroups: report AWGN, recorded MA and bandlimited Gaussian separately; do not conceal subgroup failures with pooling

working_utility_rule.status: engineering research tolerance, not clinical noninferiority margin

provenance: input hashes, frozen configurations, case keys and implementation source retained; denoisers receive observation only
paper: create a separate new manuscript; preserve all prior manuscripts and results; conclusions determined by observed comparisons
